A large electric motor is used to lift a container off a ship.
Which of the following values are enough to allow the power of the motor to be calculated?
A
the mass of the container and the distance moved
B
the force used and the distance moved
C
the current used and the work done
D
the work done and the time taken

options.label: A
options.text: the mass of the container and the distance moved

options.label: B
options.text: the force used and the distance moved

options.label: C
options.text: the current used and the work done

options.label: D
options.text: the work done and the time taken
